prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1371; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving through an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and I was turning left onto a side road. The light had been green for my direction when I started the turn.

Q: What did you see as you began the turn?

A: I checked for oncoming traffic and saw a vehicle a fair distance off. I thought I had time, so I started moving. Then another car came from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you notice that vehicle before you started the turn?

A: Not really. I looked, but I didn't see it until it was almost on me. I'm not sure if it was speeding or if my view was blocked by the vehicles stopped in the other lane.

Q: What happened to you physically after the impact?

A: My left hand hit the steering wheel and the door frame. I had a lot of pain in my wrist right away. I was taken to a hospital by ambulance, and they confirmed I had a fractured wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I have a follow-up appointment with a hand specialist.

Q: Were there any witnesses or police at the scene?

A: An officer came out and took a report. I think a man in a pickup stopped to check on us, but I didn't get his information.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to say I didn't intentionally pull out in front of anyone. I believe I was driving carefully, and I'm trying to get my hand back to normal so I can return to work.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
